metric: Mean fraction of incident power transferred across each service window, 1 - |Gamma|^2, averaged point by point over the authoritative trace. Bounded 0-1. An average 2:1 SWR is 0.889 and 3:1 is 0.750. A window with no valid measurement scores 0.
retuned_score: Mean efficiency across all services allowing the best setting per service; equal weight per service window.
fixed_score: Mean efficiency across all services for the single best configuration. Identical to retuned_score for fixed antennas.
